summary: Iteration 33: Successfully tested all modern social features from Phase 19. All 27 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified with Playwright - trending sidebar, suggested users, bookmarks, reactions popup, repost, hashtag pages, and saved posts all working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created test posts with hashtags for testing bookmark, reaction, and hashtag features
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 33 verified all Phase 19 modern social features. Key data-testids: posts-feed, post-card-{id}, post-like-btn, post-comment-btn, post-repost-btn, post-share-btn, post-bookmark-btn, post-menu-btn, reactions-popup, reaction-{type}, feed-sidebar, trending-{hashtag}, suggested-user-{id}, hashtag-page, hashtag-title, saved-posts-page, refresh-feed-btn. Login returns 'access_token'. Post creation returns 200 (not 201) but works correctly. Hashtags auto-extracted from content.

trending_hashtags_api.details: Returns list of trending hashtags with counts, works without auth

suggested_users_api.details: Returns personalized suggested users, requires auth

saved_posts_api.details: Returns list of bookmarked posts with is_bookmarked=true

reactions_api.details: Supports like, love, fire, laugh, wow, sad reactions

repost_api.details: Creates repost with optional quote, post_type='repost'

hashtag_posts_api.details: Returns posts by hashtag, includes is_bookmarked when authenticated

polls_create_api.details: Creates poll with question, options, duration

polls_get_api.details: Returns poll details with vote counts

posts_is_bookmarked_field.details: Posts in feed include is_bookmarked field when authenticated

hashtag_auto_extraction.details: Post creation auto-extracts hashtags from content

feed_trending_sidebar_ui.details: Desktop feed shows trending hashtags sidebar with clickable items

feed_suggested_users_ui.details: Desktop feed shows suggested users sidebar with profile links

feed_quick_links_ui.details: Sidebar shows Guardados, Mi Perfil, Analytics links for logged in users

postcard_bookmark_button.details: PostCard shows bookmark button that toggles filled/unfilled state

postcard_repost_button.details: PostCard shows repost button with share count

postcard_share_button.details: PostCard shows share button for native sharing

postcard_reactions_popup.details: Long-press on like button shows reactions popup with 6 emoji options

postcard_menu.details: 3-dot menu shows Eliminar (for own posts) and Compartir en mi perfil options

hashtag_page_ui.details: HashtagPage loads at /hashtag/{tag}, shows posts and related trending hashtags

saved_posts_page_ui.details: SavedPostsPage loads at /saved, shows bookmarked posts with count

bottom_nav_all_items.details: All 7 nav items visible: Inicio, Tienda, Reels, +, Mapa, Alertas, Perfil

mobile_responsive.details: Sidebar hidden on mobile, feed adapts to mobile viewport
